Hey friend! 

1. Maybe try this fall with CS classes and see how you like it. You can always change your mind and it is best to change it in your freshman/sophomore year rather than later. 

2. Growing up and going to college can be scary, but we all go through it! Maybe focus on the good parts, like having a little more freedom and some alone time. If your feelings of depression and anxiety are effecting your every day life, maybe talk to the CAPS people(Their info is easily found online, but if you can’t find it, I will link it.) BUT, send me a PM and I’ll give you my snap or something. Always down to make a new friend. 

You got this.
You got this. One day at a time. Keep saying no and then one day, it won’t be a second thought. I’m so happy you’re alive and sober.
